GET /digest
  Lists the overdue todos the todo API holds.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  200 → Digest: the overdue todos
  401 → Error: the todo API accepted no credential
source: digest/app.py::digest

GET /digest/{id}
  Reads one todo and says whether it is late.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  path:
    id  string (required) — the todo's id
  200 → Entry: the todo, and whether it is late
  404 → Error: the todo API has no such todo
  401 → Error: the todo API accepted no credential
source: digest/app.py::entry

AnOverdueTodoIsInTheDigest
Ana has a chore that is past its due day and another that is not yet due. The digest lists
    the first among the late ones and leaves the second out, and reading the first by its id says
    it is late.
TheTodoApiTurnsACallerAway\nA caller with no credential, and a caller who asks for a todo nobody added, get the todo\n    API's refusal word for word.
